panels.description: Grandmother's apartment: repaired furniture, quilts, books, photographs and recycled plants. Grandmother folds her cloth while Pilar checks a paper dose grid. Leave upper room space.
Pilar marks the next dose on the paper grid. Keep pencil and grid clear.
Grandmother calls Alex by Adrian's name, then corrects herself. Alex stands with Ada nearby. Leave upper space.
Alex studies Adrian's notebook and pump sketches while Ada sets food beside Grandmother's chair. Leave upper room space.

items.speaker: GRANDMOTHER
items.text: He said you’d know when you were ready.
